title: CLCON/204/2003 of HAYAT SINGH Vs D.J. GOVADIA BRIGADIER and ANR.

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Contempt Petition No. 204 of 2003
Ex Hayat Singh Ö Petitioner
Vs
Mr. D.J. Govadia & another Ö Respondents
Sri Alok Mehra, Advocate holding brief of Sri Manoj Tiwari, Advocate for the petitioner
Honíble B.C. Kandpal, J.
 By way of this contempt petition under Section 12
of the Contempt of Court Act, the petitioner has prayed for
summoning the opposite parties for committing willful
disobedience of the judgment and order dated 25.08.2003
passed by this Court in Writ Petition No. 770(M/B) of 2003.
2. This Court vide order dated 25.08.2003 passed by
the learned Single Judge in Writ Petition No. 770 of 2003
(M/B) issued following directions:-
ìWe are not going into the merits of the matter
because till today, Regiment, Ranikhet has not
disposed of pending representation of the petitioner
dated 8.9.2003. We are, therefore, directing the
Lieutenant Genera, Colonel of the Kumaon Regiment
to dispose of the representation of the petitioner
according to law. If necessary, the petitioner may
also be heard by the Lieutenant General, Colonel of
the Kumaon Regiment. The representation should be
disposed of within a period of four weeks from
today.î
3. The counter affidavit filed by Mr. D.J. Govadia,
Brigadier, Kumaon Regiment Centre, Ranikhet, District

2
Almora indicates that Colonel of the Kumaon Regiment & Naga
Regts and the Kumaon Scouts, Major General ñ A.S. Bahia has
decided the representation vide letter dated 20.09.2003. This
letter shows that the Colonel of the Kumaon Regement
personally scrutinizing complaint in detail and was of the
opinion that the petitioner violated the agreement on the
number of occasions.
4. The aforesaid letter has been annexed as annexure
No. 3 to the supplementary counter affidavit, which is
available on the record.
5. In view of the aforesaid, it is quite clear that the
representation of the petitioner has been decided by the
Colonel of the Region. Thus, the impugned order dated
25.08.2003 has been complied with.
6. I do not find any merit in this contempt petition.
Accordingly, the contempt petition is dismissed.
7. Notices issued to the respondents are hereby
discharged.
 (B.C. Kandpal, J.)
19.12.2008
ASWAL
